text.tspan: Slow. When this resolves, choose a Wormhole with an
endpoint at a Planet you control; place a Team Restriction
(Section 8.4, which defines Restriction) on it naming
yourself, so the opposing challenger's Assaults may not
count it as part of a path.
The Starweave Communion calls this a rite of passage, but the
passage only ever answers to the faithful — the Tangle itself is
petitioned to forget the other challenger's claim.
